correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Calussi et al. Example 4.1 exactly: Khatri–Rao M has rank 5 and kernel generator [0,-2,0,3,2,2], giving a point projection of the smooth Segre P¹×Y into P⁴. The conic Q=9z0²−18z0z1+18z0z2+11z1²+z1z2−28z2² has symmetric determinant −5913/4≠0. The center row line z=(3,2−2t,2) meets Y at two distinct points, Q|line=44t²+16t+17 with discriminant −2736. Rank-two secant decomposition uniqueness gives one double fiber, and non-tangency rules out ramification elsewhere. Independent exact arithmetic over Q(ω), ω²=−19, verifies both preimages map to q=[0:17:−51:−66:−77:−44] and five tangent image vectors have nonzero minor 2357771608607690880 ω; the branches are transverse. Their completed local intersection is C[[u,v,s,t]]/(us,ut,vs,vt). Independent Gröbner reduction of the Fitting/Jacobian 2-minors gives exactly m²; basis 1,u,v,s,t gives scheme length 5. This proves support and analytic germ rather than inferring them from degree alone.
